title: curation adjudicate-apply --json (schema 1.0)
description: Applies decisions to the verdicts without calling a model or exporting (design doc 02, section 3.9). rerun_task_success tells the Daemon what to judge again: the relabelled episodes without a human verdict.

relabel_rerun.description: the protocol recorded for this application's relabels (D39); check --modules task_success judges rerun_task_success with it. A relabel listed again because its follow-up verdict lapsed keeps the protocol recorded when it was applied
